newsitem.title: USA: Florida state lawyers ask review of Liggett papers.
newsitem.headline: Florida state lawyers ask review of Liggett papers.

text.p: Lawyers pressing Florida's lawsuit against cigarette companies want an immediate, private review of five boxes of Liggett Group documents for possible use at trial in August, lawyers said on Monday.

Liggett, the fifth-largest U.S. cigarette maker, owned by Brooke Group Ltd, last week struck a deal with Florida and 21 other states suing tobacco companies for an estimated $30 billion of government spending on sick smokers.
Part of the deal calls for Liggett to hand over industry documents, which anti-tobacco lawyers said would bolster claims in the lawsuits against RJR Nabisco, Philip Morris and other cigarette makers.

Tobacco company lawyers last Thursday obtained a temporary judicial order barring Liggett from delivering the documents as agreed, claiming some of the papers were privileged communications between lawyers and their corporate clients.
A hearing on the order is scheduled for March 31 in a Winston-Salem, North Carolina, court.
Civil attorneys for Florida, which is seeking $1 billion or more in Medicaid costs, said they wanted court-appointed special master William Rutter to review the Liggett documents in private.

Rutter has reviewed scores of other internal industry documents for the trial judge, Palm Beach County Circuit Court Judge Harold Cohen, and would recommend to Cohen whether the Liggett documents or only some of them should be used at trial.
Lawyers said the Liggett documents would be discussed at a hearing before Rutter on Wednesday morning in West Palm Beach, Florida.
Florida's suit is scheduled for trial beginning on August 4.
Last Friday Dade County Judge Alan Postman said during a pretrial hearing in a separate, class-action suit against tobacco companies that he wanted to see the Liggett documents as soon as possible.
Postman said he would enter an order next week for Liggett to produce them unless a higher court had ordered them kept secret.
